name: The Cirrusfly Queen
summary: In Thendal Grove, cirrusflies threaten the rangers of Zephras Isle. Their swarm has spread far, so Elatrell Featherlight sends you to hunt its queen and thin the flies at their source.

sections.title: Striking the Hive
sections.body: You have seen that killing worker cirrusflies does little to curb the swarm spreading through Thendal Grove. Elatrell Featherlight sends you to the grove’s southeastern reaches, where the main hive lies. The queen directs the colony and heavier soldier drones guard her.

sections.title: A Ranger's Burden
sections.body: From afar, cirrusflies may seem like petty pests. Yet the larger breeds threaten anyone who passes beneath Zephras’s boughs. Hunt down the matriarch and withstand her guards, and you prove your skill in battle. Featherlight’s rangers will give you praise and respect.

faq.q: Where is the Cirrusfly Queen located?
faq.answer: The Cirrusfly Queen nests in the southeastern corner of Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle, near the heart of the insect hive.

faq.q: Why is slaying the worker flies not enough?
faq.answer: Hunting wandering workers only thins the swarm’s outer edges. While the queen lives, she breeds aggressive soldiers and replenishes the hive, keeping Thendal Grove in danger.

faq.q: Who issues the hunt for the Cirrusfly Queen?
faq.answer: After the first reports from the forest confirm the severity of the cirrusfly infestation, Elatrell Featherlight sends you after the queen.

faq.q: What makes the queen more dangerous than regular cirrusflies?
faq.answer: Larger, more aggressive soldier drones guard the queen and defend the hive.
The hunt follows Infestation Investigation, which first revealed how widely cirrusflies had spread through the grove.

faq.q: What role does Elatrell Featherlight serve in the area?
faq.answer: Elatrell Featherlight watches over wilderness security on Zephras Isle, tracks threats in the region, and teaches new adventurers woodland tracking and ranger duties.

angles.text: As a hunter, tracking a hive queen and outmaneuvering her guards gives you an early trial in tracking and culling beasts. The local rangers’ praise is at stake.
As a Skyborne, clearing invasive swarms from Thendal Grove helps protect Zephras Isle’s natural balance and keep its routes safe for travel.
